svg.desc: The event log is aggregated into daily snapshots over the window d-7 to d-1. Snapshots go to the offline store, which a point-in-time as-of join turns into training rows, and are materialised daily into the online store, which serves the latest value per key with a TTL. A parity test compares training and serving values.

svg.text: One feature definition; two stores; the same TTL in both.
